# Bow Down Visuals

> The AI content-creation studio for all creators — YouTubers, streamers, TikTokers, podcasters, and musicians. Make songs, music videos, promo clips, thumbnails, branding, and business assets in one connected workflow (Create → Brand → Promote → Get Paid), paid for in Visual Bucs credits. Home of Thy Cheat Code, the King Shark host.

## Public Pages

These pages are readable without an account:

- [Home](/): Overview of Bow Down Visuals — the studios and how it works.
- [The World](/world): The virtual world — the King's palace and creator districts.
- [Charts](/charts): The hottest tracks, videos, and creators right now.
- [Shorts](/shorts): A vertical short-form feed of creator clips.
- [Beat Marketplace](/beats): Producers list beats; artists preview and license them by tier.
- [Shoutouts](/shoutouts): Personalized video shoutouts from creators.
- [Memberships](/memberships): Creator fan memberships and tiers.
- [Contests](/contests): Creator contests and giveaways.
- [Winners' Circle](/winners): Challenge champions and the hall of fame.
- [Storefronts](/storefronts): Browse every creator shop on the platform.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Refund Policy](/refund-policy): Refund policy.

## Public Creator Pages (one per creator or item)

- Creator profiles: /artist/{slug}
- Shops: /shop/{slug} and products at /storefront/product/{id}
- Tracks: /track/{id} · Videos: /watch/{id} · Playlists: /playlist/{id}
- Albums: /albums/{slug} · Premieres: /premiere/{id} · Live: /live/{id}
- Sounds: /sound/{id} · Hashtags: /hashtag/{tag}
- Link-in-bio pages: /bio/{slug} · Digital cards: /c/{slug}
- Press kits: /press/{handle} · Tip pages: /tips/{handle}
- Fan funnels: /presave/{slug}, /unlock/{slug}, /splits/{slug}, /join/{handle}, /plan/{slug}
- Challenges: /challenge/{slug} and /challenge/{slug}/winners
- Photo presets: /photo-preset/{slug} · Collections: /collection/{slug}

## Members-Only

Everything else on bowdownvisuals.com — the creation studios, video and
audio editors, analytics, pricing and account pages — requires a free
account and is not publicly readable.
